name: io.github.Jasonpark441/frostmailer-deliverability
title: Frostmailer Deliverability Tools
description: Free cold email deliverability checks: domain grade, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, blocklists, spam copy score.

tools.name: check_domain_health
tools.description: Grade a sending domain A to F (0 to 100) for cold email deliverability. Checks MX, SPF (including the 10 lookup limit), DKIM on common selectors, DMARC policy and DNS blocklists, then lists the fixes biggest first.

domain.description: A domain, URL or email address, for example example.com

tools.name: check_email_authentication
tools.description: Check a domain's email authentication records in detail: SPF record and DNS lookup count, DKIM keys and key length, DMARC policy and reporting, and MX records. Pass a DKIM selector if the provider uses a custom one.

domain.description: A domain, URL or email address, for example example.com

dkim_selector.description: Optional custom DKIM selector, for example s2048

tools.name: check_blacklists
tools.description: Check a domain (domain lists, plus the IPs it resolves to) or a single IPv4 address against public DNS blocklists such as SpamCop, UCEPROTECT, PSBL and SURBL. Lists that refuse public lookups, like Spamhaus, are reported as not checked, never as clean.

target.description: A domain like example.com or an IPv4 address

tools.name: lookup_mail_provider
tools.description: Find which mailbox provider a domain uses (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 and others, from MX records) and who hosts its DNS (from NS records). Useful before writing to a prospect or debugging a domain setup.

domain.description: A domain, URL or email address, for example example.com

tools.name: check_cold_email_copy
tools.description: Score a cold email from 0 to 100 for spam risk. Flags spam trigger words by category (money, urgency, overpromise, shady, unnatural) and structure problems: length, links, capitals, exclamation marks, leftover placeholders and the subject line.

body.description: The email body as plain text

tools.name: plan_sending_infrastructure
tools.description: Work out how many mailboxes and domains a daily cold email volume needs, the sends per inbox per day that keeps them healthy, and the monthly cost. Covers Microsoft (Azure) tenants, Google Workspace and pre-warmed options.

emails_per_day.description: Total cold emails to send per day

inboxes_per_tenant.description: Azure only: inboxes per tenant, 50 is standard
